property_mix.era: mixed post-war and modern; rapid industrial/commercial expansion from 1920s onwards
property_mix.notable: High proportion of rental stock and HMOs due to transient working population; significant commercial and industrial properties alongside residential areas.

locksmith_relevant: Slough's dense rental market and high tenant turnover drives frequent lock changes and emergency callouts for lost keys.
Extensive 1960s–1980s flat conversions require specialist cylinder and multi-point lock knowledge common to those eras.
Major industrial estates and business parks create demand for commercial access control and high-security locks beyond standard residential work.
